scope: Full BuildReport and actual GetFiles are preserved. Every tracked path is compared to pinned HEAD by Git, and changed candidates undergo exact bytes or narrow text/schema equivalence checks. All tracked files are SHA-256 snapshotted before/after; raw clean and byte-equality flags are never rewritten. Known serializer input versions are archived per phase. Product untracked files are rejected. Runtime shader references must resolve to their expected name/GUID before build. Semantic pass permits only EOL/trailing whitespace, the derived 16-entry runtime list clearing, and the exact disabled UnityConnect migration. No source restoration, saving, refresh or auto-refresh suppression occurs.
